content: On the other hand, a remaining concern is that our SATA Tree-LSTM is not robust to random seeds when the size of a dataset is relatively small, as tag embeddings are randomly initialized rather than relying on pre-trained ones in contrast with the case of words. From this observation, we could find out there needs a direction of research towards pre-trained tag embeddings.
